name: Move Street Cricket II
summary:
Move Street Cricket II offers an arcade-style cricket experience with simplified controls and fast-paced gameplay. It is designed to be accessible to players of all skill levels, including those new to the sport.

Just like the first game it supports PlayStation Move and features gameplay mechanics such as fielding as well as catches and throws. In addition to this it features a realistic physics engine and smooth arcade style graphics and gameplay.

The game also features split-screen multiplayer mode to play with your friends. There are mini games involved in between the gameplay such as when bowling and batting. It includes a lot of local Indian environments such as backyards, side roads, roof tops, dhaba, chawls, underbridges. You have a choice of 8 international teams to select from, each having a total of 6 players. It aims to provide real simulating batting and bowling experience with the use PlayStation Move controller.
